high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white comparison of two photographs of the same person taken two years apart. The top photograph shows the individual with long, flowing hair, wearing a simple top. The person is smiling broadly, and their hair appears to be slightly tousled, giving a natural and relaxed vibe. The bottom photograph features the same individual with a more styled hairstyle, featuring curls and waves. They are wearing a different top and have a pair of dangling earrings, adding a touch of elegance to the look.
